name: NNB Dessert House
tagline: A taste of Vietnamese late-night dessert culture
description: NNB Dessert House (Nhung Nguoi Ban — "Friends") is a Vietnamese dessert and street-food spot hidden down a fairy-lit alleyway in Sunshine, with a second location in Footscray. The menu celebrates Vietnamese late-night food culture: an array of chè (hot and cold dessert soups) with toppings chosen from a glass cabinet, homemade yogurts and jellies, plus savoury snacks like bột chiên, bò né, bún riêu, and rice paper salad. It is the perfect place for summer evening cravings — sweet or savoury — over coconut milk chè, crushed ice and flan.
services: Vietnamese street snacks (bột chiên, bò né)

testimonials.author: That's A Feed (TikTok)
testimonials.text: This hidden dessert shop in Sunshine not only sells some amazing viet chè but also a list of other famous Vietnamese street foods. After walking down this sketchy lane you'll enter a cute little dessert shop with the toppings displayed in a glass cabinet. Can't go wrong with any of their dessert — my personal favourite is number 12.

testimonials.author: Sunshine Locals
testimonials.text: A delicious hidden gem tucked away in a lovely cosy hallway-like entrance on Hampshire Road. At night you will find it lit up with fairy lights — the perfect place for your summer night dessert or savoury snack craving.

testimonials.author: Google reviewer
testimonials.text: Cozy atmosphere, reasonable prices, friendly staff and fresh ingredients. Loved the chè with coconut milk, jelly and flan on crushed ice.

atmosphere_notes: Hidden down an alleyway entrance off Hampshire Road. Cosy, hallway-like shop with bar stools, fairy lights at night, glass display cabinet of dessert toppings. Authentic Vietnamese late-night food culture vibe.
